mapper.select: SELECT T.USRNO, T.USRID, T.PWD, T.USRNM, T.ROLE, T.DELYN, T.BIRTH, T.GENDER, T.ADDR, TO_CHAR(T.RDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS RDATE, T.EMAIL, T.TEL FROM USERS T WHERE T.USRID = #{usrid} AND T.PWD = #{pwd} AND T.DELYN = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MEMBER (NUM, USRID, USRNM, LOGIN_DATE) VALUES (MEMBER_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{usrid}, #{usrnm}, SYSDATE)
